fusions.name: Vein Sipper
fusions.desc: Fires a round into the first enemy in its path for 4 damage, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Scattering Colony
fusions.desc: Fires 5 rounds in a wide spread, each dealing 6 damage. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Deafening Report
fusions.desc: The report of your shot holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2 seconds and leaves them [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Night Shooting
fusions.desc: At night, you deal 12% more damage.
